subject: Retention exception & backup purge coordination — PineBridge Labs integration
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@pinebridgelabs.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary retention buffer + DPA subprocessor update for PineBridge integration

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited to move forward. Legal at PineBridge asked me to get clarity on a couple of retention and backup items before we sign the integration addendum:

- We need a temporary exception for log/backup purging during the initial sync window (expected 6 weeks). Specifically: ability to retain incremental backups for up to 45 days rather than standard 14 so our compliance team can validate deletion/erase behavior.
- A short-term SLA for emergency erase proof (i.e., proof-of-deletion timestamp + snapshot hash) after an erase request.
- Updated subprocessor list in the DPA (we need to confirm a couple of storage providers).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: (a) grant a 45-day soft-retention on backups for PineBridge’s integration environment, (b) provide a small audit package we can hand to our auditors, and (c) accept a DPA redline? I attached PineBridge’s requirements document for background.

Appreciate a quick reply so our procurement can proceed.

Best,
Sara
Sara Patel
Legal Operations | PineBridge Labs
[sara.patel@pinebridgelabs.com]

-- Attachment: pinebridge_requirements.pdf (pdf, 210 KB)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara.patel@pinebridgelabs.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention buffer + DPA subprocessor update for PineBridge integration

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear summary and the PDF.

Short answers up front: yes, we can support a temporary retention adjustment for the integration environment; yes, we can produce a deletion/audit packet; and yes, we can accept DPA redlines subject to security signoff. A few details we need to iron out:

1) Scope: is this for a single integration environment (staging) or also for production? Our hosted default retention is 14 days for incremental backups and 90 days for immutable snapshots (longer-term snapshots are on request). A 45-day soft-retain is feasible for staging; for production we generally require a review with Security for any retention changes.

2) Trigger & rollback: we prefer a bounded window (e.g., July 10 — Aug 21) with an automated rollback to standard retention policy after the window; we can also add a circuit-breaker to immediately revert if the exception starts to impact cluster capacity.

3) Proof-of-deletion: we can provide a deletion evidence bundle that includes deletion timestamps, snapshot IDs, and S3 object version IDs plus a signed manifest from our storage system. We’ll need to confirm what format your auditors prefer.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll loop in Kimberly (Security & Compliance) to confirm the technical feasibility and provide a runbook excerpt.
- Aditya (Account SDR) will share the DocuSign link and the current DPA redline from our side.
- If possible, can you send any mandatory language PineBridge needs in the DPA (specific clauses)?

I’ve cc’d Kimberly & Aditya. We’ll aim to get you a concrete proposal (exception window, rollback plan, and evidence sample) by EOD Wed.

Thanks — talk soon.

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@pinebridgelabs.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 3 Jul 2028 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention buffer + DPA subprocessor update for PineBridge integration

Hi Sara / Tessa — I pulled the ops runbook and ran a quick capacity check. A few concrete items from Security/Infrastructure: 

- Temporary retention: we can grant a 45-day soft-retention for incremental backups in a named staging namespace. That will keep incremental backups from being GC'd for 45 days; immutable snapshots will still be subject to our snapshot SLA unless we explicitly create additional snapshots (we can do that on request).
- Rollback & circuit breaker: we’ll add an automated policy that reverts to 14-day retention if disk utilization in the cluster exceeds 72% for more than 12 hours. This is enforced by our autoscaling policy and monitored in the Console.
- Emergency erase proof: deletion evidence will contain: deletion_request_id, deletion_timestamp (RFC3339), list of object keys deleted, and a signed manifest. We can produce a signed manifest in JSON or PDF.
- Subprocessors: we currently use two cloud storage subs (US-East) and a CDN provider; we can add the exact vendor names in the DPA redline. Please note: any addition of a new subprocessor for production will need a 30-day notification.

Attachments: I attached our suggested DPA redline (dpa_redline_v2.pdf) and a short snippet from the retention runbook that shows the circuit-breaker thresholds (retention_runbook_snippet.txt).

Operational proposal (what we can do immediately):
1) Create a staging namespace for PineBridge with 45-day soft retention starting July 10, 2028 and auto-rollback Aug 24, 2028.
2) Provide a deletion-evidence sample within 48 hours of request in the requested format.
3) Send the DPA redline via DocuSign for PineBridge Legal to review — I’ll add the subprocessor appendix.

If that aligns with PineBridge’s needs I’ll kick off the runbook changes and the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

-- Attachment: dpa_redline_v2.pdf (pdf, 120 KB)
-- Attachment: retention_runbook_snippet.txt (text, 2 KB)
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@pinebridgelabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: PineBridge Legal <legal@pinebridgelabs.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jul 2028 16:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention buffer + DPA subprocessor update for PineBridge integration

Kimberly / Tessa — this looks good and is basically what our auditors need. A couple of small asks before we proceed: 

- Please include in the deletion evidence the storage object version ID(s) where possible — our auditors like to reconcile S3 versions.
- Confirm the mechanism for an immediate manual revert (who needs to sign off internally and how long the revert takes). The circuit-breaker is fine but we also need a documented manual-trigger path for emergency erase requests.

If you can add those two items in the DocuSign redline I can route to Legal and Procurement today. We’ll also need the SOC 2 audit letter (or a pointer to your SOC 2 report) to attach to our file.

If we get the DocuSign today, procurement aims to sign by EOD Friday. I’ll accept the DPA with the noted additions and the 45-day staging retention window (July 10 — Aug 24) contingent on receiving the deletion evidence sample and SOC 2 pointer.

Thanks — Sara

-- PineBridge Legal: procurement@pinebridgelabs.com
